Network Security

Capteur collecteur de flux

A network device or software agent that passively gathers, aggregates, and forwards network flow records (such as NetFlow, IPFIX, or sFlow) for traffic analysis, anomaly detection, or forensic investigation. See NIST SP 800-137 and IETF RFC 3954.

Questions and answers

What is Capteur collecteur de flux?

In this glossary, Capteur collecteur de flux refers to: A network device or software agent that passively gathers, aggregates, and forwards network flow records (such as NetFlow, IPFIX, or sFlow) for traffic analysis, anomaly detection, or forensic investigation. How is Capteur collecteur de flux used in cybersecurity?

In cybersecurity communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Déployez un capteur collecteur de flux sur le commutateur central pour agréger les enregistrements NetFlow de tous les VLANs et surveiller le trafic est-ouest et nord-sud."

Definition

A network device or software agent that passively gathers, aggregates, and forwards network flow records (such as NetFlow, IPFIX, or sFlow) for traffic analysis, anomaly detection, or forensic investigation. See NIST SP 800-137 and IETF RFC 3954.

Operational example

Deploy a flow collector sensor on the core switch to aggregate NetFlow records from all VLANs for monitoring east-west and north-south traffic.

Localized term

Capteur collecteur de flux

Localized example
